policies.protocol: schema 1, `api-` connection grammar, fixed non-emissive reply fields and typed refusal families are protocol invariants; `runtime_authorized:false`/`runtime_enforced:false` are scope truth, not operator switches
policies.operator: no new execution policy, default classification, timeout, retry or cap; the transport decision adds no budget consumption and no saved-setting write

functions: destination_digest: domain-separated canonical digest of (kind, root, connection, base_url, model, provider_source); stored key never an input — covered transitively by catalogue digests
resolve_destination: live catalogue read via preparation_api_provider; caller echo of base_url/model is the TOCTOU pin; malformed echo and unknown connection refusals distinct

destination_attribute: admin-only, current-entry policy read check, `blp-object-attribute` producer delegation (exact-once uniqueness, anti-declassification inherited), request digests only in reason, key never in reply

execute: egress lock ordering (egress→trust→settings), full capsule re-verify via preparation_admission::verify before destination checks, connection/provider_source/settings freshness trio, current-entry attribution_for on the recomputed digest, last-use no-write-down check_output, rollback-only observe_budget, publication None
observe_budget: with_material_read + unchecked_transaction + Ignore drop behavior + explicit rollback; refusal on unavailable preparation, never a default authorization
current_settings_digest: reads CURRENT saved settings history; truncated/missing history refuses instead of fabricating
HTTP mapping (service.rs:389-392) and named diagnostic regression (1668-1674): exact typed mapping 400/404/409 for the seven new codes; no prefix fallback
preparation_calls.rs Fixture::new: TMPDIR required, canonicalized, /tmp refused; birth record retained; close removes the root, Drop retains it on panic only

errors.authentication: authenticated principal and clearance before any capsule read (execute) and administrator role before attribution; possession of an admission id is not a read permission
errors.data: malformed schema/connection/echo refusals typed separately (blp-transport-invalid / blp-destination-invalid / blp-destination-echo-mismatch); admission receipt grammar distinct from transport request grammar
errors.storage: trust reservation inside egress lock; finished() folds lock-close failures preserving the primary refusal; read_bounded for state; native receipt absent() maps to blp-admission-not-found not storage
errors.effects: no journal write, no publication, no turn/reservation/SQL mutation on the decision path; budget observation is rollback-only; freshness trio refuses with typed 409 codes
errors.cleanup: egress wrapper cleanup folding; observe_budget explicit rollback with Ignore drop behavior; no /tmp allocation anywhere in the producer or journey
errors.http: seven new codes each mapped and regression-covered; ownership 404 (not 403) so a non-owner learns nothing about the capsule
